subject: executor: Use the `BaseExecutorV2` to refactor the `SelectionExec` and remove the session context inside (#54617)
summary: Diff only refactors `SelectionExec` to embed `exec.BaseExecutorV2` and cache `StmtCtx.MemTracker`, `EvalContext`, and `EnableVectorizedExpression` at build time (matching existing executor patterns like `ProjectionExec`), with all constructors updated (`builder.go`, index-join internal builder, and required-rows test helper). No correctness/semantics/concurrency/txn/session/privilege Blocker/High issues found in the touched executor behavior.
